verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec at docs.ollama.com, offers official Python and JS libraries, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, cloud API-key access, and an explicit stability and deprecation commitment. The 404s at ollama.com OpenAPI paths don't contradict this, since the spec is served on docs.ollama.com. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of driving the API, plus a formal versioning/sunset scheme (the API is not strictly versioned and OpenAI compatibility covers only a subset).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
